ports.label: To Antenna
ports.notes: BNC female, 50 ohm; from the antenna; 174-216 MHz (UA834V); +5 dBm absolute max input; do not use DC-grounded antennas or splitters

ports.label: To Receiver
ports.notes: BNC female, 50 ohm; to receiver or UA844/UA845 antenna input; amplifier powered by 10-15 V DC bias (0.60-0.72 W) from this connection; gain +6 / +12 dB; bus-powered (coax bias)
